C-TELEMETRY-CONNECTION-UI.Summary: Implement the second displayed GT7 telemetry connection mockup explicitly selected by the user on 2026-11-02.

Goals.Goal: Compact graphite home panel with console icon, connection status, white primary action, demo and connection settings.
Request C by default and move IPv4 editing, scanner and manual A/B/~/C selection to connection settings.
Preserve working connect, disconnect, demo and dashboard flows in RU and EN on desktop and narrow phones.

Constraints.Constraint: Use existing Flutter/Provider architecture, theme tokens, typed localization and pinned FVM SDK. Protocol parsing remains unchanged.
Use responsive layout, safe dialogs with scrolling and keyboard insets, real buttons and accessible labels. Preserve other home sections.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No new telemetry fields, auto-pairing, external APIs, cloud deployment, commit or push.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Home has no IP form or packet selector; Connect opens settings and real IPv4 validation, scanner and submit work.
C is requested by a new UdpService; settings permit all four formats, label ~ correctly and apply only on submit.
Connected, waiting, error and demo states remain usable; dashboard and disconnect are accessible.
Verify RU/EN at widths 320, 390, 600 and 1440 with enlarged text; run macOS and narrow iPhone Simulator, inspect screenshots and interactions.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: Dart MCP targeted tests, pinned SDK localization generation and changed-file analysis.
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: macOS and iPhone screenshots, actual taps, errors inspection, source-to-render design QA.
